Xpendiq reads your bank\'s transaction alerts from your notifications, on your device.
📲 Only Google Messages & Samsung Messages are watched
🔕 OTPs and promo alerts are filtered out
⚙️ You can revoke this from Settings any time
Allow Xpendiq to read transaction alerts

To record your spending automatically, Xpendiq reads notifications from your messaging apps — Google Messages and Samsung Messages — to find bank transaction alerts like UPI and card payments.

This happens only on your device. Your messages and notifications are never uploaded, shared, or sent anywhere. Only bank transaction alerts are saved — OTPs and promotional messages are ignored.

You can turn this off any time in Settings.
